name: Vibentra v1.2.5 - Permanent Playlist Deletion & Sync Update
changelog: 🗑️ Permanent Playlist Deletion: Deleted playlists are permanently purged locally and in Cloud Firestore, never reappearing
☁️ Cloud Sync Guard: Blacklist sync prevents deleted playlists from being resurrected across app launches or devices
🎵 100% Real Live Tracks: Authentic, dedicated tracklists for every JioSaavn & YouTube album & playlist
📱 Mobile Playlist Controls: Dedicated Delete Playlist & Delete Songs buttons on all mobile views
⚡ High-Definition 320kbps Audio: Ultra fast CDN stream delivery with background audio persistence
